news.headline: How AI is redefining Wall Street jobs — and boosting demand for this new 'hottest skill' by 1,721%
news.summary: Banks are on a hiring spree for AI engineers skilled in "agent orchestration," the art of coordinating teams of specialized agents to work in tandem. This emerging capability is reshaping how financial institutions deploy artificial intelligence across trading, risk management, and client services. The demand reflects Wall Street's race to automate complex workflows and stay competitive in an AI-transformed market.

educational.title: Why Company Earnings Move Stock Prices So Much
points: Stock prices reflect expectations — earnings reports test if those expectations were right
Beating profit estimates doesn't guarantee a stock rises if guidance disappoints
'Guidance' — a company's own forecast — often matters more than the past quarter
Markets move on the surprise, not the number itself
This is why a profitable company's stock can still crash on earnings day
